description: Adopt prepared Engram reads in TP4 native-KV single-item DMA prefill. The DSpark shared-anchor fixture changes its 4032- and 4160-row DMA steps: two private-ID uploads and two prepared gathers, each joined on four target streams and completed after status. Existing allocations, handles, modules, per-stream launch arguments/order, transport, status operations and every other fixture remain identical. Exact positional edits account for moved gather uploads and independent cross-rank decoder launch interleaving.
